sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of the following words is a Proper Noun?
In the story 'The Crow', how did the clever crow drink the water?
options: B) He dropped pebbles into the pot.
D) He waited for the rain.
questions.answer: B) He dropped pebbles into the pot.

questions.question_text: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo. (Choose the correct article)
The children are ___ in the park right now.
The little cat is hiding ___ the table. (Choose the correct position word)
Based on 'This is My Town', where do we go to buy stamps and post letters?
I like to eat apples ___ bananas. (Choose the joining word)
According to 'We are all Indians', what is our national bird?
'The smart monkey tricked the crocodile.' What is the describing word (adjective) here?
What do we use to end a question sentence?
From the chapter 'Seeing without Seeing', how do we know a flower is nearby without looking at it?
questions.answer: We can know a flower is nearby by smelling its sweet scent with our nose.

questions.question_text: Write two fun things you can do with your bicycle.
questions.answer: I can ride it to the park with my friends and ring its loud bell.

questions.question_text: According to the poem 'Little Drops of Water', what do little drops of water make?
questions.answer: Little drops of water make the mighty ocean.

questions.question_text: Who do you write a letter to when you want them to 'Come Back Soon'?
questions.answer: I write a letter to my grandmother or a friend when I miss them and want them to come back.

questions.question_text: Rewrite this sentence using a pronoun instead of the name: 'Riya is my friend. Riya likes to read.'
questions.answer: Riya is my friend. She likes to read.

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with the correct form of the doing word (verb): 1. The monkey ___ (jump/jumps) on the tree. 2. Yesterday, I ___ (walk/walked) to school. 3. She is ___ (sing/singing) a sweet song. 4. They ___ (is/are) playing.
Match the singular naming word (noun) with its correct plural form: 1. Bus, 2. Child, 3. Leaf, 4. Box. (Options: Leaves, Boxes, Children, Buses)
Imagine you are looking at 'A Show of Clouds' in the sky. Describe two shapes you see and what they look like they are doing. (3-4 sentences)
questions.answer: I looked up at the sky and saw a big cloud that looked like a fluffy white rabbit. It was hopping across the blue sky. Next to it, there was a cloud shaped like a giant ship sailing on the wind.

questions.question_text: Describe your route from 'Home to School'. Mention at least two places or things you see on the way. (3-4 sentences)
questions.answer: When I walk from my home to school, I first cross a small green park where children play. Then, I pass by a busy bakery that smells like fresh cake and bread. Finally, I see the big red gate of my school.
